ai.title: Refactor knowledge.md into AGENTS.md and docs/
ai.summary: Split monolithic knowledge.md into AGENTS.md for core conventions and multiple docs/ files for agents, dev, env, and testing. This modularizes documentation for easier maintenance and targeted reference. Covers root AGENTS.md, docs/agents-and-tools.md, docs/development.md, docs/environment-variables.md, and docs/testing.md.

eli5.text: The project's main instruction manual has been reorganized: the single large file was split into a quick-start guide at the top of the folder and several shorter, focused guides inside a new 'docs' folder, each covering one topic (core conventions, dev setup, tools, environment, testing). If you open the repository you will now see several smaller documents instead of one thick one, so people building or extending the assistant can find what they need faster without scrolling through unrelated material.

ai.title: Add evalbuff docs optimization loop and handleSteps generator patterns
ai.summary: Introduced `evalbuff/` subsystem for automated documentation optimization via iterative agent evaluation. Added `docs/patterns/handle-steps-generators.md` detailing correct `handleSteps` generator signatures, `spawn_agents` tool call structures, and `STEP` yielding patterns to prevent TypeScript errors. Moved legacy evalbuff CLI and agent definitions to `evalbuff/old/` while updating `AGENTS.md` with new subsystem and documentation links.

eli5.text: The project has added a new system that will automatically study how well the coding assistant reads and follows the project's written guidance, then quietly rewrite those instructions overnight to fix whatever the assistant gets wrong so it improves on its own. At the same time, the old version of that system has been moved into an archive folder, and a short guide has been added explaining how to correctly structure step-by-step automation without triggering type errors. If you looked, you'd see a fresh folder where the improvement loop lives and a new how-to document, though no improvement runs have actually been executed yet.

ai.title: AGENTS.md simplified, opencode submodule removed
ai.summary: AGENTS.md updated to reflect current architecture, adding freebuff and evalbuff descriptions while removing obsolete goals, request flow, and conventions sections. opencode submodule deleted. Repo-only change; no user-facing behavior or API impact.

eli5.text: The internal guide for contributors was cleaned up: extra files were removed and outdated sections were deleted, while the project's stated purpose was rewritten to focus on building one flexible learning agent that includes two tools (the free agent and the eval helper). A leftover reference to an unrelated side project was also removed. This is live in the repository today. If you browse the project on GitHub, you'll see a shorter, simpler guide and one fewer extra entry in the code.
